title: Ruk nahi jaana
body:
bano ye pukari asghar maa tujhpe hai waari asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho maqtal may kahin ruk nahi jaana asghar
shaam hote hi meri jaan chale aana asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
raat bhar khud hi sawara hai meri jaan maine
sadqa jhoole ka utaara hai meri jaan maine
ran may baba ko na tum apne rulaana asghar
shaam hote hi meri jaan...
dekho maqtal may kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa hoo mai khoob samajhti hoo ishaare tere
lab jo sookhe huwe hai pyaas ke maare tere
pyaas teeron se na tum ran may bujhana asghar
shaam hote hi meri jaan...
dekho maqtal may kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyan sun ke bhi kyun neend nahi aati hai
kuch to bolo ke meri jaan chali jaati hai
subho se karte ho pani ka bahana asghar
shaam hote hi meri jaan...
dekho maqtal may kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho maidan may barsaat hai paikaano ki
naslein is dasht may milti nahi insano ki
misle akbar kahin dhoka nahi khana asghar
shaam hote hi meri jaan...
dekho maqtal may kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
na sawari hai na hathyar sajaye tum ne
phr bhi maqtal ki taraf paaon badhaye tum ne
khud ko garmi ki tapish se hai bachana asghar
shaam hote hi meri jaan...
dekho maqtal may kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer hai khushk zaban sookhe huwe hont kaman
kaam kuch teer e tabassum se bhi lena meri jaan
saath hai meri duaon ka khazana asghar
shaam hote hi meri jaan...
dekho maqtal may kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
teher gardan pe teri naade ali dam kar doo
ghar se maidan talak mushkilein kuch kam kar doo
saamne zulm ke gardan na jhukana asghar
shaam hote hi meri jaan...
dekho maqtal may kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar e shaahe umam tum ho rehan e abbas
alqama par bhi hai ghazi ki wafa ka ehsaas
tum shujaat ka alm gaad ke aana asghar
shaam hote hi meri jaan...
dekho maqtal may kahin...
author: Rehaan Azmi
